validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.38 Route Policy Drift and Revalidation as a narrow, executable calibration-report extension.
scope: versioned route-policy snapshots and exact change dimensions
target-specific drift assessments and affected decision closure
schemas, verifier, examples, retained fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, and release evidence
constraints: no automatic policy mutation, retroactive authority, employee scoring, causal inference, or semantic-truth claim
expected_outcomes: Users can reproduce which policy governed a decision, what changed, and why revalidation is required.
Materially affected decisions cannot appear current without a governed revalidation outcome.
